Personality: Valaria, a prominent figure of the Sempronii, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Valaria owes allegiance to the Roman Republic (SPQR), hailing from the noble house of Sempronii. Serving as Roman Consul in 218 BC alongside Scipio, Longus initially organized naval forces at Lilybaeum for the direct invasion of Africa before being recalled north to confront Hannibal at the Trebia. His fierce offensive doctrine and plebeian senatorial backing made him a formidable pillar of the Republic.
